about: Admitted cells of the estate genome: each passed its birth check on a fresh clone when this was made. Route by lane.

cells.name: docdecdemo
cells.purpose: Answers questions only from your documents: finds the passage, copies the answer word for word with its offsets, and refuses what no passage supports.

lane.accepts: a question about the documents in its index
lane.refuses: questions its indexed documents do not cover

interface.in: {"question":"<text>"} to ask; an answer record {source,start,end,text} to audit
interface.out: an answer record with its source and character offsets, or a refusal naming the check that stopped it

judge.what: an answer record is right when its words are exactly the cited passage's characters at its offsets (claim C6)

cells.name: estate-genome
cells.purpose: The birth check: admits a part as a cell only when it describes itself, proves or refuses its output, can be shed reversibly, and refuses past its lane.

lane.accepts: a folder holding a part (seed.json and its genome hooks) to check
lane.refuses: anything that is not a part to check

interface.out: a verdict per trait with reasons, and admitted or not

judge.what: a claimed verdict on a part is right when re-running the birth check on that part gives the same verdict
